cleaner.label: Pub (Dart and Flutter)
cleaner.description: Dart packages downloaded to the Pub cache. Does not touch programs installed with dart pub global activate (bin, global_packages) or projects.

option.label: pub.dev packages
option.description: Removes the packages downloaded from package servers (hosted).
option.warning: Projects will not build until you run `dart pub get` or `flutter pub get` again.

option.label: Packages from Git repositories
option.description: Removes the Git repositories downloaded as dependencies (git).
option.warning: Projects will not build until you run `dart pub get` or `flutter pub get` again.
